name: qrcode-barcode-scanner
title: QR Code & Barcode Scanner
description: Read every QR code and barcode in an image from Finder or the clipboard, then copy each decoded text or the full scan report.
author: qrcode-ai-com

commands.name: scan-image
commands.title: Scan Image for Codes
commands.description: Read the QR codes and barcodes in the image selected in Finder, or in the image file on the clipboard, and list each decoded text.

preferences.name: qrscanPath
preferences.title: qrscan Path
preferences.description: The full path of the qrscan program. When empty, the extension looks in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin and ~/.cargo/bin.

preferences.name: profile
preferences.title: Scan Profile
preferences.description: Full searches longest and reads the most damaged codes. Fast and Frame stop sooner.
